items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: In the band there was Buster Bailey, Charlie Shavers and myself in the front line

ctx.x: Oh, I didn't know. Yeah, I went with Kirby's band in 1947, and we did a short up in the Bronx. I mean, that wasn't a short. That was a feature picture. But we were just in a cabaret spot. In the band there was Buster Bailey, Charlie Shavers and myself in the front line, and there was John Kirby, there was Fuller, the drummer...no, Big Sid was the drummer... John Kirby, Big Sid and...
